title: Select filter component audit
purpose: Audit select as a native dropdown filter with browser limitations made explicit.
objective: Define select anatomy, placeholder/all option, native limitations, focus/disabled states, responsive behavior, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: label, native select, placeholder/all option, option data, focus/disabled states, browser styling limits, responsive behavior, and QA scenario. Out of scope: custom enhanced select implementation and other filter types.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current select render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A select audit sheet exists with native constraints and safe styling controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: Safe style controls are separated from risky enhanced-select ideas.
acceptance_criteria: Audit does not pretend native select is fully controllable.
No plugin source changes are made.
